Read input: rtlpp_04410_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_04410(
   input clk,
   input [11:0] data,
   output out,
   input load_data,
   input RSTn,
   input load_start,
   input load_stop,
   input load_ack,
   input load_nack
);

reg [24:0] shift_reg;
integer i;

assign out = shift_reg[24];

always @(posedge clk or negedge RSTn)
begin
  if (~RSTn) 
  begin
    shift_reg <= 25'h0AAAAAA;
  end
  else 
  begin
    if (load_data)
    begin
      for (i=0; i<12; i=i+1)
      begin
        shift_reg[2*i+2] <= ~data[i];
        shift_reg[2*i+1] <= data[i];
      end
      shift_reg[0] <= 0;
    end
    else if (load_start)
      shift_reg <= 25'h02AAAAA;
    else if (load_stop)
      shift_reg <= 25'h1AAAAAA;
    else if (load_ack)
      shift_reg <= 25'h12AAAAA;
    else if (load_nack)
      shift_reg <= 25'h0AAAAAA;
    else
      shift_reg <= {shift_reg[23:0],~shift_reg[0]};
  end
end

endmodule
